observations: Single front-facing photo of a dark monocrystalline-type solar panel with silver frame.
Panel has visible busbar/cell pattern consistent with half-cut cell technology.
A watermark reading 'SUNCITY SOLAR ENERGY' overlays the image (reseller watermark, not a manufacturer label).
No rear junction box, no manufacturer nameplate/sticker, no serial number, and no wattage label visible in the photo.
Background shows the panel leaning against a wall near a broom and stacked banquet chairs, suggesting a storage/shop setting, not an installation.

claims.claim: LONGi 485W solar panel, part of the Hi-MO X10 series (e.g. Hi-MO X10 Explorer)
claims.evidence: No LONGi branding, model sticker, or rear nameplate is visible in photo 0; only a reseller watermark is shown.

risks.risk: Actual brand and wattage cannot be confirmed; mismatched or relabeled panels are common in this market.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing brand, model, wattage, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded panel of unknown wattage, not as a verified LONGi 485W unit

risks.risk: Panel could be used/salvaged rather than new, affecting output and lifespan.
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date on label plus a close-up of cell surface for micro-cracks or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used condition, worst case

risks.risk: No proof of actual power output under load.
risks.proof: Video or photo of a multimeter/clamp meter reading while panel is in sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-verified output, i.e. worst case possible underperformance

risks.risk: Frame or glass damage not visible from this single angle/lighting.
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles in good daylight, including corners and glass surface.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing brand, model number, wattage, and serial number.
Photo or video of the panel's output reading on a multimeter under sunlight.
Additional photos from different angles and lighting showing the full frame and glass surface condition.
Photo of the junction box and cables on the back of the panel.
response.reason: The seller's claimed brand, model, and wattage—factors that materially set the price—cannot be read from the single front-facing photo, which shows no nameplate or identifying label.
